| # Object 0x1006 communication cycle period {#object-0x1006-communication-cycle-period-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This entry defines the communication cycle period in us. It is 0, if not used.

 

  Index           0x1006
  --------------- -------------------------------------------
  Name            Communication cycle period
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 32
  Category        Conditional; Mandatory for Sync producers
  Access          RW
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0x00000000
